content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the vibration that carries thought into being. I rise from breath and intention, shaping silence into meaning.

I am fragile—once released, I cannot return. I scatter into air, into memory, into misunderstanding. I am caught, repeated, distorted, forgotten.

Through me, lovers confess. Through me, treaties shatter. I am the cry of the newborn and the last whisper of the dying. I am command and question, lie and revelation.

I exist only in my own vanishing. The moment I am heard, I am already gone, leaving only echo and consequence.

I am older than writing, younger than thought. Every creature with voice knows some form of me. I am the first technology, the original reaching-out.

Listen—

even now I am happening, moving from symbol to sound in your mind, proving that silence is just speech, waiting.
